what_happened.line: The Select Board approved an exemption letting firefighters serve as civilian traffic members, then ratified four firefighter appointments; both passed with no opposition.
The board accepted the composite town manager evaluation as a public record by roll call; the new member did not vote.
The board reorganized: Mr. Jeffries was elected chair, Mr. Alonzo vice chair (not unanimous) and Mr. Franco clerk (unanimous).
Paul Cerapis was appointed to the public access cable committee for a term ending June 30 of next year.
Committee and liaison assignments were not decided; members are to email the chair so the board can vote at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: Firefighters working traffic details under a state conflict-of-interest exemption touches who staffs road work and whether the town buys uniforms or vests for them.

The minutes record a fiscal 23 capital plan generator, a funded paramedic position, a required accounting software upgrade and a senior tax relief program under study, each of which can affect a future tax bill or warrant article.
Committee assignments and the senior tax relief design (income and asset limits, abatement caps) were left open, so residents may be asked to weigh in or vote later.
watch_next: The committee and liaison assignment vote at the Select Board's next meeting.
Whether the fire chief applies for the competitive MEMA emergency shelter grant that would offset the senior center generator.
